title: 1983 Topps - All Star #404 Gary Carter Montreal Expos
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 1983 Topps sports trading card features Gary Carter of the Montreal Expos, card number 404. It is a part of the base set and was manufactured by Topps. The card is from the Major League Baseball (MLB) league and depicts Carter in the All-Star Game. The card is not autographed and is a great addition to any baseball fan's collection. The season the card represents is 1983.
